explication: This repository publishes Ethereum proof-of-stake consensus specifications and includes a Python generator that turns Markdown specifications plus preset/configuration data into fork-specific Python spec modules. The principal workflow is selecting a fork and build target, locating inherited and fork-specific documents, parsing them, and assembling generated spec content. The README also identifies rendered viewers and reference tests as consumer-facing capabilities; their publishing and test infrastructure are not mapped here. The generation path is based on sampled source and the source index; links to unsampled assembly details are omitted.
